chapter: The McShann band on the road and at the Savoy
title: The band's shabby uniforms and non-stop playing
summary: They had one uniform, cardboard stands and pinned-on derbies, and sweated through every set.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Well, now, I've read that the McSharry band arrived in New York, a raggedy band with raggedy sound. Were the uniforms beaten up or anything?
Well, we had a blue coat and brown pants.
I mean, the photographs of the band on the stand looked quite sharp.
Yeah, well, now, that was the uniform we had.
But we had cardboard stands, we had -- bought the music -- like, the metal music racks?
And the guys went and got derbies and had them pinned on, you know. In other words, the stuff -- everything we had was so shabby looking, and we only had that one uniform, you know.
And we all -- at that time every guy in that band would get soaking wet, because we would --
Sweat, yeah. From the time we hit that first note until the time we got off that bandstand, we didn't let up.
